recommendation: Keep this fix. It preserves the already-applied element and modeling guidance while completing the explicit deprecated-code exclusion from the published OO decision; no broader Observation or generic precondition change is supported by the evidence.
issue_request: FHIR-17380 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for OO. It requested adding patient fasting status to Specimen.collection as a 0..1 choice of CodeableConcept, extensibly bound to HL7 v2 table 0916 excluding the deprecated concept, or Duration, with documentation that Observation precoordination or component representation is possible but not recommended.
initial_application: Commit 1e393840340e8a3496634052422cf0e9018e7d9b initially applied GF#17380 to the Specimen spreadsheet, adding fastingStatus[x] with CodeableConcept|Duration, a FastingStatus binding, and the Observation modeling guidance. The 2021 source rework carried the element into source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml. Before this reconciliation, current source had the element, choice types, extensible binding, and guidance, but still pointed at the full THO v2-0916 value set rather than excluding deprecated FNA.
additional_context: Specimen is active in source/fhir.ini, so the StructureDefinition and companion diagram are current build sources. THO 6.5.0 marks v2-0916 code FNA as deprecated while ValueSet/v2-0916 composes the full code system. OO minutes and the Jira resolution both include the deprecated-concept exclusion, and a 2025 terminology Zulip thread confirms the practical issue that Specimen exposed both NG and deprecated FNA through the unfiltered binding.
reconciliation: Added source/specimen/valueset-specimen-fasting-status.xml to import THO ValueSet/v2-0916 and exclude CodeSystem/v2-0916 code FNA; updated Specimen.collection.fastingStatus[x] to bind to the new local value set; and updated the checked-in Specimen SVG binding link/text to match the authoritative StructureDefinition.
source_changes: source/specimen/valueset-specimen-fasting-status.xml: added a build-scoped Specimen value set that includes THO v2-0916 and excludes deprecated code FNA.
source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml: changed Specimen.collection.fastingStatus[x] from the unfiltered THO v2-0916 value set to the new filtered Specimen Fasting Status value set.
source/specimen/specimen.svg: updated the checked-in resource diagram binding link/text to match the filtered value set.
